answer: An agent economy resists sybils by requiring each head to seal a unique operational diary and open random pages for peer check. Farm heads that share one controller tend to retell the same fable under different names, so opened seals cluster into one plume of correlated histories. The ledger then merges that plume into a single reward share. Honest diaries fan out like a willow's branches, each leaf a real counterparty or timestamp absent from every other seal.
